headline: BepAはフタ状の部分を外膜に差し込み、BAMで活性化する
subhead: BAM複合体と結合したBepAのクライオ電顕構造で、α6-lidが外膜に入り、AI-plugが外れていた

summary.question: 亜鉛を使う分解酵素M48ファミリーは自己阻害プラグで不活性に保たれるが、プラグが外れる仕組みは不明だった。
summary.approach: 変異体のスクリーニングと生化学で調べ、基質が停滞したBAMに結合したBepAをクライオ電顕で解析した。
summary.result: BepAのα6-lidのループは長いヘリックスになって外膜に差し込まれ、AI-plugは活性部位の亜鉛から外れていた。
summary.learned: α6-lidが外膜に刺さってBepAをBAMに固定し、AI-plugを外すことで、必要な場所とときだけ酵素が働くと考えられる。
summary.open: BepAが基質の停滞をどう感知してα6-lidを差し込むのかは、まだ分かっていない。

question.quote: Members of the widespread M48 metalloprotease family are kept inactive by an autoinhibitory plug that blocks catalytic water activation, but how this plug is released remained elusive.

approach.quote: Here, using genetic, biochemical and cryo-EM approaches, we discover the activation mechanism of BepA, a quality-control protease that preserves outer membrane integrity by surveilling the β-barrel assembly machinery (BAM) in Gram-negative bacteria. Our cryo-EM analysis of BepA engaged with a stalled BAM-substrate assembly complex

result.quote: In turn, the otherwise disordered loop (residues P175 to T197) connecting α6 to α7 folds back and extends α7 by ~30 Å, forming a helical hairpin with α6 that projects into the lipid bilayer and packs against F785, F802 and F804 of BamA β15-β16
This conformational cascade results in the disengagement of H246 as the fourth ligand to the catalytic Zn2+

learned.quote: This membrane anchoring promotes displacement of the autoinhibitory plug and unlocks protease activity precisely where and when it is needed.
Thus, a dual enzyme activation mechanism is coupled to membrane association under stress, ensuring that BepA remains inactive until properly localized.

open.quote: How substrate stalling is initially sensed by BepA remains unresolved.

highlights.text: α6-lidを欠くBepAは、BamAやLptDと相互作用できない。SurAを欠いて外膜タンパク質の折りたたみがつまる条件では、野生型BepAは膜に結合するが、α6-lidを欠く変異体はペリプラズムに残った。

evidence.quote: Moreover, deletion of the α6-lid led to a marked accumulation of LptDC even in the presence of R252H (Fig. 3g) and abrogated interactions between BepAE137Q and both BamA and LptD (Fig. 3h).
Remarkably, in the absence of SurA, BepA became exclusively membrane-associated, whereas BepA∆α6-lid remained in the periplasm (Fig. 5a).

highlights.text: BamAのバレルが閉じたNb32複合体ではBepAはBAMに結合するがプラグは亜鉛に配位したままで、基質が加わって開いたNb5複合体でだけ活性型だった。著者は、基質の停滞でバレルが長く開くことが活性化に要ると推測している。

evidence.quote: The EM density for the AI-plug region is poorly defined, indicating increased flexibility in the α8-α9-α10 loops, yet the α9 AI-plug remains coordinated to the catalytic Zn2+, maintaining the enzyme in a locked state.

We speculate that only stalled OMPs result in sufficiently long opening of BamA barrel and exposure of β15–β16 strands and β12–β13 loop region for BepA activation, a conformation that may be too transient during constructive OMP folding.

highlights.text: bepAのランダム変異ライブラリーを、外膜が漏れるとピンク色になる色素CPRGで選別した。AI-plugを支えるD205とR252、フタのG166など、活性の調節に関わる残基が見つかった。

evidence.quote: Transformants with increased outer membrane permeability allow CPRG to enter the cell, where it is hydrolyzed, producing a detectable pink color31 (Fig. 1b).
Thus, D205 and R252, which are interconnected by hydrogen bonds, appear to function in tandem to stabilize the AI-plug that blocks the catalytic site

lab_notes.expression: E. coli BW25113に、strepタグ付きBepA #127/E137Q変異体（pBAD42）を導入し、0.2% L-アラビノースで37℃・3時間誘導。
lab_notes.construct: BepA #127変異体（A149G・L169S・Q176H・G184C）に触媒欠損E137Qを加えた。BamAに対するナノボディNb5またはNb32を加えて複合体を安定化。
lab_notes.purification: 1.5% DDMで全細胞を溶かし、Strep-Tactin XTで精製。ナノボディのHisタグでNi-NTAによる2回目の精製を行い、LMNG中に溶出。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 酸化グラフェンをのせたQuantifoil R2/1（銅300メッシュ）に約0.1 mg/mLを3 μL塗布。CP3プランジャーで背面から4秒ブロット。
lab_notes.data_collection: JEOL CRYO ARM 300（300 kV）＋K3、カウンティング、60フレーム・総線量60 e-/Å2。RELION 5.0.1とcryoSPARC 4.7.1で処理し、EMReady2で鮮明化。

evidence.quote: BepA#127/E137Q-strep was purified using Strep-Tactin®XT 4Flow® high-capacity resin (IBA)

To separate BAM-engaged BepA from the pool of free periplasmic BepA, the BepA#127/E137Q-strep elution was mixed with BamA-binding nanobodies Nb32 or Nb5, and subjected to a second affinity purification using the Nb C-terminal hexa-histidine tag. To do so, the mixture was then loaded onto an equilibrated 0.2 ml HisPur™ Ni-NTA Spin Columns (Thermo-Fisher).
BepA overexpression was induced by adding 0.2% L-arabinose at 37 °C for 3 h.

For a sample application, 3 µl purified BepA-BAM-Nb complexes (~ 0.1 mg/mL) were applied onto GO grids, subjected to 4 s backside blotted to remove excess liquid, and flash-frozen in liquid ethane using a CP3 plunger (Gatan).
Image stacks were recorded in counting mode with a cumulative electron dose of 60 electrons per Å2 spread over 60 frames
Final maps were then sharpened using EMReady251 and used for model building and refinement.

editor_notes: 本文は完結。BepA-BAM の構造は初出だが、論文は『初』とは言っていない（first_structure は false、BamA の既存構造は多数）ので「初」は使わない。9SOW(Nb5, 3.23 Å, 基質結合・BamA バレル開) と 9SOX(Nb32, 6.4 Å, 閉) の2構造。基質は同定できない未同定のβストランド（LptD かもしれないが断定不可）、ナノボディが状態の分布に影響した可能性を著者も注記。BAM-BepA の『活性型』は触媒欠損E137Q変異体で捕えたもの。

figure_evidence.quote: with the notable exception of the AI-plug (residues R234 to P249) and the α6-lid (residues Q154 to T197)
forming a helical hairpin with α6 that projects into the lipid bilayer
